ValidationRule.description: Agents cannot manually update a case status to Consumer Reply Received, Analysis Done
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "US"), $UserRole.Name = 'CCNA Frontline Agent', ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,'Consumer Reply Received'), ISPICKVAL(Status,'Analysis Done'), ISPICKVAL(Status,'Bottler Follow up Completed') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Agents are not allowed to select certain status i.e. Consumer Reply Received, Analysis Done and Bottler Follow up Completed.
